reason: Accepted DEC-LITIGATION-030 requires EvidenceUse to come from `factual_basis_refs` preserved inside each eligible CourtRecordEntry. The existing VS-005 `SubmissionService.materialize_court_record` does not copy `factual_basis_refs` into CourtRecordEntry; it exists only on FinalizedDocument/DraftWorkProduct. The contract simultaneously requires `submission_service.gd` to remain unchanged, excludes it from the allowlist, and forbids adjudication from consulting DraftWorkProduct or other private prior objects to repair missing record provenance. Implementing the recognized path would therefore require either an unauthorized SubmissionService change or semantics contrary to the Accepted design. No production files, canonical logs, Git HEAD, or index were changed. Contract/design revision is required to authorize provenance preservation in CourtRecordEntry or explicitly define another allowed-record source.
